typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Contact Source} as string,
		{Contact Source Type} as string,
		{Subscriber ID} as string,
		{Topics Covered} as string,
		{Contact Date} as date,
		Notes as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource	source(output(
		Description as string,
		ContactSourceLookupID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT  rtrim(ltrim(Description)) as Description, LookupID as ContactSourceLookupID FROM useradm.Lookup WHERE LookupTypeID = 10',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupContactSourceLKPTABLE	source(output(
		Description as string,
		ContactSourceTypeLookupID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT  rtrim(ltrim(Description)) as Description, LookupID as ContactSourceTypeLookupID FROM useradm.Lookup WHERE LookupTypeID = 11',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupContactSourceTypeLKPTABLE	source(output(
		SubscriberID as string,
		MemberID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select  DISTINCT SubscriberID, MemberID from member.Member',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupforMemberIDLKPTABLE
FlatFileSource,LookupforMemberIDLKPTABLE lookup({Subscriber ID} == SubscriberID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupforMemberID
LookupforMemberID split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupforMemberIDIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupforMemberIDIsMatch@Match,LookupContactSourceLKPTABLE lookup({Contact Source} == Description,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupContactSource
LookupforMemberIDIsMatch@NotMatch derive(dc_ErrorDescription = toString('Matching <SubscriberID> not found in Lookup table')) ~> SubscriberID
LookupContactSource split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupContactSourceIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
SubscriberID sink(input(
		ContactSourceType as string,
		ContactSource as string,
		Remarks as string,
		SubscriberID as string,
		TopicsCovered as string,
		ContactDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Notes as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ContactSourceType = {Contact Source Type},
		ContactSource = {Contact Source},
		Remarks = dc_ErrorDescription,
		SubscriberID = {Subscriber ID},
		TopicsCovered = {Topics Covered},
		ContactDate = {Contact Date},
		Notes)) ~> OLEDBDestination2
LookupContactSourceIsMatch@Match,LookupContactSourceTypeLKPTABLE lookup({Contact Source Type} == Description,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupContactSourceType
LookupContactSourceIsMatch@NotMatch derive(dc_ErrorDescription = toString('Matching <Contact Source> not found in Lookup table')) ~> ContactSource
LookupContactSourceType split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupContactSourceTypeIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
ContactSource sink(input(
		ContactSourceType as string,
		ContactSource as string,
		Remarks as string,
		SubscriberID as string,
		TopicsCovered as string,
		ContactDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Notes as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ContactSourceType = {Contact Source Type},
		ContactSource = {Contact Source},
		Remarks = dc_ErrorDescription,
		SubscriberID = {Subscriber ID},
		TopicsCovered = {Topics Covered},
		ContactDate = {Contact Date},
		Notes)) ~> OLEDBDestination
LookupContactSourceTypeIsMatch@Match derive(dc_createUserID = $v_createUserID,
		dc_createDate = $v_log_EventDate) ~> AddCreateDateandCreateUserID
LookupContactSourceTypeIsMatch@NotMatch derive(dc_ErrorDescription = toString('Matching <Contact Source Type> not found in Lookup table')) ~> ContactSourceType
AddCreateDateandCreateUserID derive(dc_createUserID = dc_createUserID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
ContactSourceType sink(input(
		ContactSourceType as string,
		ContactSource as string,
		Remarks as string,
		SubscriberID as string,
		TopicsCovered as string,
		ContactDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Notes as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ContactSourceType = {Contact Source Type},
		ContactSource = {Contact Source},
		Remarks = dc_ErrorDescription,
		SubscriberID = {Subscriber ID},
		TopicsCovered = {Topics Covered},
		ContactDate = {Contact Date},
		Notes)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		{} = _Notes)) ~> OLEDBCommand
